cards.p: A lead asked about [address] on [site]. Write a short reply with two showing times and one question.
This lead went quiet [weeks] ago: [notes]. Write a friendly check in with one easy yes or no question.
Write a thank you text for open house visitors at [address]. Mention [feature], offer a second look.
Write 8 questions for a first call with a buyer: budget, areas, must haves, timing, loan status.
Write a listing description for [address] from my notes: [notes]. 120 words. Describe the home, not the buyer.
Write a shot list for [address]: 15 photos in order, which room, which angle, what to tidy first.
Write a short post and email: [address] is now [new price]. Lead with the best feature, not the price.
Turn these details into a one page feature sheet with short headings: [paste details].
Write a text asking the buyer's agent for feedback on [address]. Three quick questions, under 50 words.
Write my weekly seller update for [address]: showings [number], feedback [paste], next step. Calm and honest.
A buyer must move their [time] showing at [address]. Write a reply offering two new times.
Turn my notes from today's showings into a table: home, likes, dislikes, buyer score out of 10: [paste].
Turn my closing steps into a plain email for first time buyers: what happens, when, what they do: [steps].
Write a text [days] after closing asking [name] for a review. Mention one detail from their move, add [link].
Reply to this unhappy review: [paste]. Thank them, own one fair point, offer a call. Under 60 words.
Write a short note asking [name] if they know anyone moving this year. Thank them first, no pressure.
Write a just listed post for [address]: 3 best features, price [price], open house [date]. Under 80 words.
Explain this month's local numbers in plain words for a post: [paste numbers]. No predictions.
Write a short guide to [area] from my notes: [notes]. Coffee, parks, getting around. 5 lines.
Plan 5 posts leading to my open house at [address], [date]. One line and a photo idea each.
Sort my expenses into marketing, car, signs, fees, other: [paste]. Total each. Flag anything charged twice.
An agent owes me a [amount] referral fee for [address], [days] late. Write a polite reminder with a date.
Turn my calendar notes into a mileage table: date, from, to, purpose, miles: [paste].
Here is my spend and deals by lead source: [paste]. Which source works best? Show a table.
